versions.changelog:
- Initial release of godfery-agent-builder.
- Build complete OpenClaw agent workspaces from scratch or iterate on existing agents.
- Interactive, multi-phase workflow: clarifying interview, file generation, guardrails checklist, and acceptance test prompts.
- Supports designing agent persona, operating rules, autonomy model, guardrails, heartbeat, memory, and skill roster.
- Generates and tailors core workspace files (`SOUL.md`, `IDENTITY.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `USER.md`, `HEARTBEAT.md`) using strong defaults and user input.
